name: lingovoice-ai
description: LingoVoice AI - Full-Stack AI Voice Language Tutor

scripts.install:all: npm run install:server && npm run install:client
scripts.dev: node -e "const { spawn } = require('child_process'); const isWin = process.platform === 'win32'; const cmd = isWin ? 'npm.cmd' : 'npm'; const s = spawn(cmd, ['run', 'dev:server'], { stdio: 'inherit' }); const c = spawn(cmd, ['run', 'dev:client'], { stdio: 'inherit' }); process.on('SIGINT', () => { s.kill(); c.kill(); process.exit(); });"

author: LingoVoice AI Team
